title: Designer Manager (Interior Fit-out)
description:
**Job Summary**

The Design Manager is responsible for leading the design team in delivering innovative, functional, and cost-effective interior design solutions for commercial, retail, hospitality, healthcare, and residential fit-out projects. The role ensures that all designs meet client expectations, project timelines, quality standards, statutory regulations, and budget requirements while coordinating closely with project management, estimation, procurement, and execution teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Lead and manage the interior design team, including architects, interior designers, and CAD/BIM professionals.

- Develop creative design concepts, space planning, layouts, and presentation materials based on client requirements.

- Review and approve design drawings, working drawings, shop drawings, and construction details.

- Coordinate with clients, consultants, MEP engineers, contractors, and vendors throughout the design process.

- Conduct design presentations and client meetings to obtain approvals and address design changes.

- Ensure all designs comply with local building codes, safety regulations, and industry standards.

- Collaborate with the estimation and procurement teams to ensure design feasibility and cost optimization.

- Monitor project design schedules and ensure timely delivery of all design milestones.

- Resolve design-related issues during execution and provide technical guidance to site teams.

- Review material specifications, finishes, furniture selections, and mock-ups before final approval.

- Implement quality control procedures for design documentation.

- Mentor and develop junior designers through regular reviews and technical guidance.

- Drive innovation by introducing new materials, technologies, and sustainable design practices.

- Coordinate with planning and project management teams to minimize design revisions and delays.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

- Professional certifications in design software or project management are an added advantage.

**Required Experience**

- 10–15 years of experience in interior design and fit-out projects.

- Proven experience in commercial office, retail, hospitality, healthcare, and residential interior projects.

- Experience in leading multidisciplinary design teams and handling multiple projects simultaneously.

**Technical Skills**

- AutoCAD

- SketchUp

- Revit

- 3ds Max

- V-Ray / Enscape

- Adobe Photoshop

- Microsoft Office

- Knowledge of BIM coordination and design documentation.

**Key Competencies**

- Leadership and team management

- Client relationship management

- Strong design visualization and presentation skills

- Technical detailing and problem-solving

- Project coordination

- Time management and multitasking

- Cost-conscious design approach

- Decision-making and negotiation skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

- Timely completion of design deliverables.

- Client satisfaction and design approval rate.

- Accuracy and quality of design documentation.

- Reduction in design-related site revisions.

- Compliance with project budgets and timelines.

- Effective coordination with execution and project teams.

- Team productivity and development.

- Successful delivery of projects meeting quality and commercial objectives.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: On the road

title: Product Designer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience of our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will design across web, Android, and iOS — from the first-time student onboarding to live classes, tests, doubt-solving, and the purchase flow. You will work closely with product, engineering, content, and marketing to ship interfaces that hold up at scale: lakhs of students, low-end Android devices, patchy networks, and peak-hour traffic during exam season.

This is a hands-on craft role with real ownership. You will not be handed wireframes to prettify — you will be in the problem from discovery through to shipped pixels and post-launch iteration.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the design for one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content discovery, doubt-solving, or growth and monetization — from problem framing to shipped UI.
* Translate product requirements into user flows, information architecture, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity screens.
* Talk to students, parents, and teachers directly — run usability sessions, watch session recordings, and turn what you see into design decisions you can defend.
* Design mobile-first, and design for the real device: low-end Android, 2GB RAM, unstable networks, small screens, and one-handed use during study hours.
* Build and maintain our design system — components, tokens, typography, spacing, iconography, and states — so that web, Android, and iOS stay consistent as the team scales.
* Partner with engineering on handoff: specs, redlines, edge cases, empty states, error states, loading behaviour, and what degrades gracefully when the network drops.
* Design conversion surfaces with the growth team — landing pages, paywalls, pricing pages, checkout, referral flows, and push/in-app notification patterns.
* Support A/B experiments — design variants worth testing, define what a win looks like visually and behaviourally, and iterate on results rather than opinions.
* Use behavioural data (Hotjar, Mixpanel, CleverTap, GA, or similar) alongside qualitative research to find friction and prioritise what to fix.
* Contribute to visual and brand consistency across product, marketing creatives, thumbnails, and app store assets in collaboration with the design and marketing teams.
* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, Allen, and adjacent consumer apps) and bring back patterns worth borrowing or beating.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 2–4 years of product design experience on a consumer-facing product — EdTech, e-commerce, fintech, or any other high-traffic website or app.
* A portfolio showing 2–3 shipped case studies with the problem, your process, the trade-offs you made, and what changed after launch. Portfolio is mandatory for this role.
* Strong command of Figma — components, variants, auto-layout, prototyping, and file hygiene others can actually work in.
* Solid UX fundamentals: user flows, information architecture, interaction patterns, and a real understanding of when to break a convention and when not to.
* Strong visual craft — typography, layout, hierarchy, colour, and spacing that survives contact with a live product.
* Experience designing native mobile (Android and iOS) with an understanding of platform-specific patterns and guidelines, not just responsive web.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system in production.
* Comfort working with engineers on feasibility and trade-offs — you know roughly what is cheap to build and what is not.
* Ability to run lightweight user research and usability testing yourself and synthesise it into decisions.
* Clear communication — you can present a design to founders, explain the reasoning, take critique without flinching, and change your mind when the argument is better.
* Working familiarity with a modern product-design toolchain. You do not need all of these, but should be strong in Figma and comfortable picking up the rest: Jira, Sketch, Adobe Illustrator, Miro, Maze, Dovetail, Hotjar, Adobe XD, Photoshop, After Effects, Lottie, Notion.
* High ownership and comfort with ambiguity — you can start from a one-line problem statement and come back with a direction.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, test-prep, or any learning product with real student outcomes attached.
* Experience designing assessment and test-taking interfaces — question players, timers, OMR-style inputs, result and analytics screens.
* Experience with live streaming or live class interfaces — chat, polls, hand-raise, playback, and low-bandwidth states.
* Experience designing for Indian users at scale — vernacular and Hinglish content, price sensitivity, shared devices, and first-time smartphone users.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and designing for readability over long study sessions.
* Motion and micro-interaction skills — Lottie, After Effects, or Figma prototyping for handoff-ready motion specs.
* Exposure to growth loops, referrals, and content funnels — especially YouTube/Shorts traffic converting into app users.
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS or design tokens, enough to speak the same language as front-end engineers.
* Formal design education (NID, IIT design programmes, or equivalent) — not required if the portfolio is strong.

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you care whether a 17-year-old actually understands the screen, not whether it looks good in a Dribbble shot.
* First-principles thinker who can simplify a messy problem and give the team clarity.
* Comfortable going from a whiteboard sketch to pixel-level polish in the same week.
* Craft-obsessed but pragmatic — you know when to ship at 80% and iterate.
* Collaborative — you earn trust with engineering, product, and content rather than defending territory.
* High-agency — you spot problems nobody assigned to you and take them on.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: UI/UX Developer
description:
Job description:

**Company:** CSG Technosol Private Limited  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** Freshers & Experienced Candidates Can Apply  
**Hiring Mode:** Walk-In / CV Submission  
**Starting Salary for Freshers:** ₹15,000 per month  
**Commitment for Freshers:** 2 Years Written Commitment

**About the Role**

CSG Technosol is looking for a **creative and passionate Frontend (UI/UX) Developer** who has a strong sense of design, aesthetics and user experience. We are looking for someone who doesn’t just write frontend code, but can **think creatively about how a product should look, feel and interact with users**. The ideal candidate should be enthusiastic about modern web design, responsive interfaces, animations, usability and emerging UI/UX trends.

**Freshers with strong creativity, good fundamentals and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop **modern, attractive, responsive and user-friendly web interfaces**.
* Convert concepts, wireframes, Figma designs and requirements into functional frontend interfaces.
* Create engaging layouts with a strong focus on **UI/UX, typography, spacing, colors, usability and visual consistency**.
* Build responsive interfaces that work smoothly across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
* Develop reusable frontend components and maintain clean, structured code.
* Work with modern frontend frameworks and libraries.
* Create smooth **animations, transitions, micro-interactions and interactive user experiences** where appropriate.
* Collaborate with backend developers, designers and project teams to build complete applications.
* Optimize frontend applications for **performance, accessibility, responsiveness and cross-browser compatibility**.
* Continuously explore new UI/UX trends, tools, frameworks and technologies.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

Candidates should have knowledge of, or a strong interest in, technologies such as:

* **HTML5 & CSS3**
* **JavaScript / TypeScript**
* **React.js and/or Next.js**
* **Tailwind CSS / Bootstrap / Material UI or similar modern UI frameworks**
* Responsive & Mobile-First Design
* Modern CSS, Flexbox & CSS Grid
* UI Components & Design Systems
* REST API integration
* Git / Version Control
* Basic understanding of frontend performance and SEO

Knowledge of the following will be an added advantage:

* **Figma / Adobe XD or similar UI/UX design tools**
* Framer Motion / GSAP or other animation libraries
* Shadcn/UI or other modern component libraries
* React Native or other mobile UI technologies
* Accessibility (WCAG) principles
* AI-assisted design and development tools

**Most Important: Creativity**

For this role, **creativity matters as much as technical knowledge**.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can:

* Think beyond standard templates.
* Create visually impressive yet practical interfaces.
* Understand what makes a UI feel modern and premium.
* Pay attention to small design details.
* Suggest improvements instead of simply following instructions.
* Understand the user’s perspective while designing an interface.
* Keep themselves updated with modern UI/UX trends.

**Eligibility**

* Freshers as well as experienced candidates can apply.
* Candidates from **B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc. IT/CS, Diploma, or other relevant technical backgrounds** are preferred.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they have strong frontend/UI/UX skills and a good portfolio.
* Freshers should have good fundamentals and be willing to learn modern frontend technologies.
* A portfolio, GitHub profile, live project, Figma design, or sample UI work will be an advantage.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
